app_tagline: AI-Assisted Livestock Health for Pakistani Farmers

landing.hero_subtitle: AI-powered livestock health triage — connect with verified veterinary doctors across Pakistan
landing.step1_desc: Select your animal and describe what you're seeing — fever, swelling, loss of appetite, and more.
landing.step2_desc: Our AI assistant gives you a preliminary assessment, urgency level, and safe first-aid advice in seconds.
landing.step3_desc: Get matched with a verified veterinary doctor who reviews your case and provides professional guidance.
landing.trust_desc: Every doctor on Malshifa is manually verified by our team. We check PVMC registration numbers and degree certificates before any doctor can accept cases.
